relations.rationale: Study group membership is unrelated to arrival time at an event.
Dara-Rosa same group and Dara-Tess different group are logically consistent and somewhat expected if Rosa and Tess differ, but doesn't directly support or contradict.
Study group membership has no bearing on Dara's physical state after a race.
Study group membership is unrelated to ambient sound at a finish area.
Sun breaking through clouds at the five-minute warning is unrelated to the crowd moving toward corrals.
Weather conditions before a race are unrelated to laughter echoing after the race.
People moving to corrals is unrelated to whether Quinn is the event organizer.
Movement toward corrals has no bearing on study group membership.
Moving toward corrals is a precursor consistent with the crowd surging forward at the horn, supporting the sequence of events.
Quinn's role as organizer is unrelated to Dara and Tess's study group membership.
Quinn's organizer status is unrelated to Dara's emotional/physical state after finishing.
Quinn's non-organizer status is unrelated to Uma's placement in the race.
Quinn's role is unrelated to ambient laughter at the finish area.
Rosa not sharing a group with Tess is consistent with and slightly supports Dara also not sharing with Tess, though not guaranteed.
Quinn glancing at a clipboard is unrelated to Uma cheering for others.
Quinn glancing at a clipboard is unrelated to laughter echoing at the finish area.
Uma's early arrival is unrelated to Tess adjusting her shoelaces.
Uma's early arrival is unrelated to the sound of sneakers on pavement.
Uma arriving early is unrelated to when Dara crosses the finish line.
Arriving earlier than others doesn't directly determine or preclude placing in the middle of the pack in a race.
